SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KTPI' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(SUBSTRING(LEGACY_PR_NO,5,7),' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(ITEM_AMT,0) AS ITEM_AMT, ISNULL(ADD_DATE,' ') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(RD_DATE,' ') AS RD_DATE, ISNULL(DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, ISNULL(PURCHASER_USER_ID,' ') AS PURCHASER_USER_ID, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME, ISNULL(SELLER,' ') AS SELLER, ISNULL(PRE_GR_FLAG,' ') AS PRE_GR_FLAG, ISNULL(REMARK1,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(REMARK2,' ') AS REMARK2 FROM VIEW_PO, KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_1 = LEGACY_PO_NO AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T') ORDER BY KEY_1,KEY_2
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND KEY_10 in (' ','T')
